snippet.title: WARDOGS | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
SIGN UP NOW FOR FUTURE PLAYTESTS: https://community.wardogs.com/signup/community

WARDOGS is a Tactical All Out Warfare FPS where one hundred players split across three teams fight over the control zone. Set in the derelict industrial mountains of Eastern Europe on a destructible battlefield where cash is earned, and cash is king.

Wishlist WARDOGS now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1867240/WARDOGS

www.wardogs.com

WARDOGS X: http://twitter.com/wardogs
WARDOGS Discord: https://discord.gg/TxKKdspkCp
